description: elec_lead's onStartFight extra hit (bundle.deobfuscated.js:61187-61292) must re-invoke traits_config's OWN whenAttacked/afterAttack (called via `this` inside onStartFight, which the source binds to the raw traits object, never the merged wrapper or the ability config -- see README). Nonfatal: Rattata's huge HP survives Pikachu's opening hit, so afterAttack must fire and elec_chain (gated on the ATTACKER being Electric-type) must grant Pikachu +1 speed stage from that extra hit alone, before round 1 even starts. Pre-fix Python never calls after_attack for elec_lead at all, so this stage change -- and everything downstream it perturbs (turn order, subsequent rounds) -- was missing.
